excerpts: The SPRINT trial showed benefit of comprehensive treatment to a target BP of <120/80 mm Hg.
It is especially the case for younger individuals, those with DM, and those with high lifetime CVD risk based on the presence of multiple risk factors, including high BP.
Further research on improving accuracy of office BP measurements, including number of measurements, training of personnel measuring BP, and device comparisons is needed.
research_needs: Reproduction of ambulatory and home BP measurements
Include wider range of ethnicities in trials
Assessment of ABPM and HBPM in practice
Accuracy and usability of cuffless devices and other noninvasive BP measurement techniques
